previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson, a male with a history of mixed Hodgkin's and non-Hodgkin's lymphoma involving the central nervous system and eyes, was admitted for his eleventh cycle of high-dose methotrexate and rituximab chemotherapy. He presented in stable condition with only stable bilateral eye floaters and no new neurological or systemic symptoms. He received methotrexate at 6 g/m² with leucovorin rescue, hydration, and urinary alkalinization for renal protection, along with rituximab premedicated with dexamethasone and Benadryl. Methotrexate levels declined appropriately, reaching 0.13 µM by the day before discharge. A brain MRI showed no evidence of lymphoma recurrence, with findings unchanged from prior studies. He tolerated treatment well without acute toxicity or complications. He was discharged home in stable condition on aspirin, multivitamin, and PRN eye drops, with instructions to complete leucovorin and attend follow-up in two weeks.

radiology_notes.text:
HISTORY:  A ___ man with CNS lymphoma, with lack of involvement status
post 17 cycles of MTX and rituximab therapy.  Evaluate for status of CNS
lymphoma.

MRI OF BRAIN:  Sagittal T1, axial T1, axial gradient echo, axial T2, axial
FLAIR, and diffusion-weighted images were performed.  After uneventful
administration of gadolinium IV contrast, axial T1, coronal T1, and sagittal
T1 post-contrast weighted images were obtained.

COMPARISON:  MRI ___.

FINDINGS:  On FLAIR sequences, there is high signal in the left posterior
centrum semiovale (8:22), unchanged in location or size compared to the prior
examination.  Two smaller foci in bilateral frontal lobes (8:24), FLAIR signal
are also unchanged.  There are no new areas of abnormal FLAIR signal.  These
lesions do not enhance on post-gadolinium sequences.  There are no new
suspicious masses.  There is no shift of normally midline structures. The
ventricles and sulci are stable in their configuration, with slight asymmetry
of the lateral ventricles with the left ventricle being larger than the right.
Vascular flow voids are patent.  The paranasal sinuses, ethmoid and mastoid
air cells are without fluid.  On gradient echo sequence (6:23) is an area of
low signal which may represent unchanged region of blood products at prior
site of disease/ biopsy.  There are no new areas of gradient echo
susceptibility artifact.  There is no edema or evidence for vascular
territorial infarction. There is no mass effect.  There is minimal unchanged
FLAIR hyperintense signal in the periventricular white matter, likely sequela
of small vessel microvascular infarcts.

IMPRESSION:
1.  Stable study since ___, without evidence for enhancing
lesions.
